observer_timing_scope: Parent pre-launch clock sample to completion-notification clock sample, at one-second resolution. Includes launch, reasoning, tools, report writing, and notification delay; not exclusive model time.

context_boundary.supplied_project_context: Saved prompt and complete prepared package.
context_boundary.evidence: Invocation settings are observed directly. Access account is the actor's retained report; no independent filesystem-access audit is available.

method.recorded_edit_surface: Typed set, append, edit, and up operations through the supplied receiver and CLI.
method.auxiliary_tools_reported: Shell and Python for read-only instruction/log/export inspection and exact-number-preserving comparison; plain-text report written separately.
method.trial_boundary: One actor continuation of a complete prototype checkpoint. No general success rate, independent security isolation, component resolver, or workflow cost advantage is established.

result.evidence_authority: Fresh actor execution plus pre-existing task oracle run by the producer; not independent third-party certification.

repairs.draft_repair: String false at /mock_state/queue/paused replaced with boolean false through one typed set after the required schema rejection.
repairs.negative_test_correction: Ordinary terminal quotes produced valid declared number/boolean inputs. Actor retained those successful calls and then tested escaped literal quotes, which rejected. Parent evaluator separately rejected an explicitly typed machine string for queue pause.
repairs.broader_unexercised_catalog_predicates: Retained verbatim in CONTINUATION-REPORT.txt; prior application tests remain separate evidence.

interaction.response_scope: Includes launcher rejection events without an input command.
interaction.timing_overlap: Receiver durations include their nested process time; do not add the two columns.

mechanics: Retain actor input, observed invocation settings, additional context account, resulting files, and evaluator probes separately.
rationale: A passing outcome and a fresh task invocation answer different questions; preserve the evidence and its limits for each.
consequence: Do not turn one successful continuation or recorder byte counts into universal independence, reuse, or economic claims.
